value.title: tmux-full-body
value.summary: tmux delivery types the FULL framed body into the pane — the pointer/inbox rung is retired for tmux-reachable seats (Jordan 2026-09-01: tmux is instant; the pull is an extra turn).

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Ruling rulings/2026-09-01-tmux-types-full-bodies.md (vendored in assets/inputs/): for a pane seat with no socket rung (copilot/codex CLI; any seat when the socket is unavailable), rs must tmux-submit the full framed body as the turn. Today the drain worker announces a body-free pointer (crates/daemon/src/pointer/mod.rs:40-45) and the seat must pull pij inbox — an extra turn per message. Politeness gate unchanged: typing veto and composer-idle still govern WHEN; a busy composer queues and retries, never degrades to a pointer.

sections.name: goals
value: New delivery behavior: Pointer rung replaced by full-body tmux submit for pane seats without a socket
Body framed by the ONE shared formatter (crates/core/src/framing.rs, plan 118) — head [pij-rs from X] and tail [/pij] intact

Bodies >1022 bytes arrive INTACT (the macOS pty chunk hazard woodpecker measured: send-keys silently keeps only the tail) — chunked typing or tmux load-buffer/paste-buffer, coder probes and picks with evidence
Delivery outcome recorded honestly: typed-to-pane is its own receipt class, distinct from socket InjectedToTransport and from any reader-read ack

sections.name: non_goals
value: Claude socket path (untouched — socket remains the preferred rung)
The park-after-N announcer for genuinely unreachable seats (no pane = Observe/Queue as today)
s121 consent stamping (separate unit, separate worktree)
Reader-read receipts for typed delivery — tmux has no ack; do not fake one
